description: Use after search_flights when the traveler wants a specific return, or the next leg of a multi-city trip (once per remaining leg). Takes an outbound itinerary_id; returns complete itineraries with the trip total, needs_leg false once the trip is whole. Filters apply to the leg being chosen. Not needed for an outbound watch.

airlines.description: Only these marketing carriers, as IATA codes or names.

arrive_after.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.

arrive_before.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.

carry_on_bags.description: Carry-on bags per traveler; prices then include the bag fees, as price_with_bags next to the fare.

checked_bags.description: Checked bags per traveler; fees are priced only for flights within the US and Canada (elsewhere the answer says they are not included). Prices then include them, as price_with_bags next to the fare.

connecting_airports.description: Only itineraries that change planes at these airports (codes or city codes), nonstops included: for 'US connections only' name the hubs.

currency.description: The traveler's currency, when they name one or their words show where they live (euros in Spain, or writing in French from Lyon). Empty: US dollars or their SlickTrip currency. Amounts you send stay US dollars.

depart_after.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.

depart_before.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.

display.description: compact: one line per option, more options, far fewer tokens; full: every field (what the cards draw). Empty: compact when the app shows no cards, full when it does.

exclude_airlines.description: Leave out itineraries with any flight sold by these carriers (IATA codes, names or an alliance), by flight number or airline name: for 'not Gol' or 'avoid Air India'.

exclude_connecting_airports.description: Leave out itineraries that change planes at these airports (codes or city codes).

itinerary_id.description: An outbound (or partial multi-city) itinerary_id from search_flights or a previous call.

lower_emissions.description: Only itineraries with lower emissions than is typical for the route.

max_duration_hours.description: Longest itinerary to show, in hours.

max_layover_hours.description: Longest layover allowed at every connection, in hours (half hours allowed): for 'layovers no longer than 5 hours'.

max_price_usd.description: Highest fare to show, USD, as the TOTAL for all travelers: for a per-person budget, multiply by travelers (2 at $300 each = 600). A bucket list's price bar is per traveler instead.

max_stops.description: Most stops allowed: 0 nonstop, 1, or 2 (2 or more: any number).

min_layover_hours.description: Shortest layover allowed at every connection, in hours (half hours allowed): for 'at least 2 hours to connect'.

no_overnight_layovers.description: Leave out itineraries with an overnight layover: for 'no overnight at the transit airport'.

name: search_return_flights

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

filters.description: Filters as the caller gave them

highlights.description: The spread over every matching return: cheapest, cheapest_nonstop, fastest, earliest, latest

itineraries.description: Items: itinerary_id, price, return (round trip) or next_leg (multi-city) leg object, needs_leg

legs_chosen.description: Multi-city only: leg objects chosen so far

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

note.description: Guidance on totals and next step

outbound.description: Leg shape: airlines, stops, duration_minutes, segments, layovers

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

search.description: Route dict plus search_key, outbound_itinerary_id; multi-city adds leg_number, legs_total

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

track_url.description: Outbound handoff tracking link (round-trip path only)

title: Search return flights
